verification_report.summary: The proof is correct under the explicitly stated real-polyhedral definitions. Sequential verification confirms the raywise convexity and balancing-cone criterion, the weighted Laplacian formula, and the dimension equivalence. Both contact-set perturbations preserve convexity, the obstacle bound and admissible growth. When dim K>1, the extreme-ray construction produces exactly the claimed envelope and a strictly negative orthogonality integral. The bounded reference-shift identity and the nonsaturated tripod computations are valid. For the graph theorem, the local rank-one condition makes positive vertex mass sufficient for the compactly supported raising perturbation; subdivision, bounded edges and cycles cause no obstruction. The trivalent corollary follows because the embedded, pure-dimensional setting guarantees distinct incident rays. The cited results and contextual definitions were checked against [BMPS26](https://arxiv.org/html/2603.08664v1) after the required arXiv theorem search and web fallback. The real-affine envelope extension is valid, and the proof explicitly avoids the source's integral-slope closure problem. No critical errors or gaps were found.
